hypothesis: Join `user_features_pure.csv`'s `user_active_degree`, `follow_user_num_range`, `fan_user_num_range`, `register_days_range` as four new categorical fields in the FM (currently the model only sees raw `user_id`, which degrades to a shared UNK slot for the ~1.6-3.6% cold-start users noted in EDA and gives zero personalization signal beyond ID memorization for everyone else). These profile fields give the model transferable, generalizable user signal that isn't dependent on having seen that exact user_id in train.
expected_effect: GAUC improves more than nDCG@5, since these fields primarily help per-user ranking quality (especially for low-frequency/cold-start users) rather than top-5 ordering within a session.
